title: WorkPulse overtime.verified v1
description: HR confirmed an approved overtime request; hours are accepted exactly as requested (PO Decision 3). Identifiers, the work date, hours and the verifying actor only — the reason and notes are PII and never leave the database (`.ai/security.md`).

employee_id.description: Employee the request belongs to (UUIDv7 string). Also the Kafka message key (ADR 0012).

work_date.description: The single day the overtime was worked (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

hours.description: Verified overtime hours as a JSON number (ADR 0017); identical to the requested figure. A count, never an amount.

verified_by.description: Actor user id that verified the request (ADR 0010 — never the requester).
